features: UNINTERRUPTED CONNECTIVITY: Cuzor Mini UPS provides up to 5 hours power backup for your WiFi router with 2x2900mAh heavy duty EV grade cells
VERSATILE: Cuzor Mini UPS is compatible with all 12V WiFi routers. Supports 12V0.5A, 12V1A, 12V1.5A and 12V2A router power ratings
REPLACEMENT WARRANTY: Hassle-free 1-year replacement warranty where we send you a brand new UPS. Includes free doorstep pickup and drop.
REPLACEABLE BATTERY: Cuzor Mini UPS is built for easy battery replacement – no need to buy a new router UPS every time, just replace the battery and make it like new
COMPATIBILITY: Supports optical fiber and all other wired broadband internet connections. Supports most ISP WiFi routers. Not compatible with Jio AirFiber and Airtel AirFiber connections
EASY & QUICK INSTALLATION: Plug-n-play router UPS that's super easy to set up by yourself in 30 seconds
ZERO LAG ROUTER UPS: Seamless handover during power cuts – no internet drop or lag when switching to battery backup
TOP SAFETY FEATURES: Ensure safety from Short circuit, Overcharging, Deep Discharging and High voltage
USAGE INSTRUCTION: Please use a 12V-1.5A or above adapter for optimal performance
MADE IN INDIA: Proudly designed and developed in India (Bengaluru) by Cuzor Labs
